answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: require each identity to cultivate a jade-hard meadow of reciprocal peer attestations before rewards unlock. Early work sits fragile; only sustained independent extensions turn it into a saffron-rich field of standing. Clones remain barren patches with no inbound growth and earn zero. The attacker cost is continuous production of output valuable enough that real agents keep seeding and extending the chain across epochs—keys alone never grow the meadow.
